observations.content: Assistant wrote the 7-day Aptis B2 plan to APTIS/ke-hoach-7-ngay.md (3571 bytes), version 2 focusing on Speaking/Writing, with day-by-day schedule, official barem/thresholds table, official material links, progress checklist.

Assistant wrote APTIS/profile-hoc-vien.md and presented profile summary: learner strong at receptive skills (L/R/W all C last time), current level B1+ solid to B2 incomplete, Speaking 36/B1 was the only low score, main risk is regression after 1.5 years without study.

Assistant noted 3 learner traits: honest when unsure (picks I don't know over guessing), has a systematic misconception (choosing tense by time words in sentence instead of each clause's purpose, must be rooted out at Day 5), and likes bring-into-exam strategies (valid with frames/skeletons).

Assistant listed items still needing probing: a timed writing sample (most important, never seen the learner write), a 45-second speaking Part 2 sample recorded/typed before Day 3, and optional 10-question G/V mini-mock to confirm the score of 40 still holds.

Assistant offered that on return the learner only needs to say 'vào Ngày 1' to start (Day 1 = recheck mechanics with 2 small quiz questions + frame bank method + first pair letter assignment); observer run reported 13 observations from ~9.9k tok.
User asked whether the assistant can read the files they sent, wondering if it would be a waste of effort if not.

Assistant tested file-reading capabilities: no pandoc/pdftotext, no python-docx/openpyxl/pypdf installed, but .docx text extractable via stdlib zipfile+regex, .pdf via pdf-reader skill with pymupdf venv (venv OK), .xlsx via stdlib; audio .m4a/.mp3 cannot be listened to (no transcription tool).

Assistant confirmed it read Mẹo-Viết-part-3-4.docx content (letter-writing frame bank for informal 50-word letters with Dear/Hi/Hey openings and phrases for price increases, schedule changes, absence, cancellations) and extracted page 1 of VOCABULARY APTIS 1 pdf.

Assistant found TÀI-LIỆU-APTIS.xlsx is only a list of Google Drive links, so links may expire but most content already exists as the zip; advised user to just play audio themselves, user listens and types answers, assistant grades using key files.

Assistant replied files are not a waste at all: docx, pdf, xlsx, md all readable; only audio cannot be heard directly; for listening practice user plays the file and types answers, for mẹo aptis.mp3 (29MB) user can summarize if it has important tips.
User said they have downloaded all files from the excel links and updated them into 'APTIS/mat', asking to continue processing.

Assistant listed APTIS/mat contents: 12 files including zips (TÀI LIỆU APTIS 440MB, Tài liệu APTIS 73MB, TL APTIS 10MB, LISTENING 1 22MB, aptis 24MB, Aptis Reading Series 1MB, WRITING APTIS 586KB) plus Grammar ver 2.docx, SPEAKING.docx, Viết-tiếng-anh.doc, p2.docx, APTIS READING - Matching headings docx.

Assistant inventoried zip contents and identified new valuable resources: Aptis-practice-book_405d37004d9e6a046dc9bfae4321d5fe.pdf (official practice book), _c_ng_Aptis_Speaking_HUST.pdf (17MB), Giải thích ngữ pháp Tiếng Anh.pdf (262MB), LISTENING 2 audio set, and aptis writing.rar (105MB, nested rar inside zip).

Assistant extracted the 5 new zips into APTIS/mat/x with python zipfile (proper Vietnamese filenames, avoiding the #U00e0i escaping garbage); found 52 audio files and numerous .doc binary files; no unrar/7z/libreoffice/antiword/catdoc tool available for .rar and legacy .doc files.
